english.name: Welcome to XSOverlay
english.description: You opened the overlay. Good job.

schinese.name: 欢迎来到 XSOverlay
schinese.description: 你打开了悬浮窗。干得漂亮。

english.name: A true multitasker, huh?
english.description: You must be the real hackerman.

schinese.name: 真会一心多用，对吧？
schinese.description: 你肯定是真正的黑客高手。

english.name: Why?
english.description: Why'd you even do that though?

schinese.name: 为什么？
schinese.description: 可你到底为什么要这么做？

english.name: Trying to go somewhere?
english.description: I guess you made it then, huh?

schinese.name: 想去哪儿呢？
schinese.description: 看来你还是走出去了，是吧？
